name: feasible-corridor-dev-v1
hypothesis: Using observed asphalt outer edges and the complete obstacle sprite width to select a vehicle-width feasible passing corridor prevents head-on stalls and unsafe late side changes without worsening active-route finishes or contact safety on already consumed cells.

evaluation_budget: Exactly 55 consumed paired cells: seven legacy, 16 observed-margin screen and 32 rejected ego-switch screen. Reuse the 32 current-screen control receipts only after exact frozen lineage and receipt-manifest checks; execute the older 23 control cells and all 55 candidate cells in separate cold workers (78 canonical new episodes). First execute the fixed ten-cell mechanism triage (20 paired rows; 18 new cold episodes). The full 55-cell comparison is mandatory-gated on a matching triage summary and all 20 frozen rows. Triage permits expansion only when no control finish is lost, no new crash DNF occurs, no both-DNF paired progress declines, no operational/receipt/hash failure occurs, and at least one candidate action trace changes. Contact/damage increases are recorded but do not veto consumed development expansion. No repeat is an independent geometry sample.
decision_rule: This is consumed development evidence only. Report actual Agent-route completion, progress, completed-lap time, per-cell contacts/damage and the source-bound comparison decision, including any REJECT from contact or damage. The mandatory ten-cell triage gate controls expansion to full 55; a favorable complete development result can justify preregistering a separate fresh study, never direct activation or SOTA promotion. Fresh safety and generalization gates must be set before fresh episodes.
limits: The55 pairs represent19 distinct geometry seeds because all four IDs share geometry for each screen seed, and seven legacy cells include one geometry each.
